searchLog: Third consecutive day of total WebFetch egress blocking (2026-09-04, 2026-09-05, 2026-09-06). Confirmed via /root/.ccr/__agentproxy/status that this session's egress policy is non-selective ("selective": false) with a fixed allowlist covering only package registries and Anthropic's own API (npm, pypi, crates, api.anthropic.com, etc.) — every other domain is denied by design, not by a transient relay error. Verified by direct WebFetch attempts against job-board APIs (boards-api.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io), company domains (anthropic.com), third-party mirrors (jobs.generalcatalyst.com), and a neutral control (en.wikipedia.org) — all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED. WebSearch still works (it surfaced live Anthropic Applied AI Architect reqs and general-catalyst/indexventures mirror listings) but hunt.md requires confirming open-status, eligibility, and deadline from the actual application page before including anything, which is categorically impossible while WebFetch is blocked. Zero opportunities written rather than padding with unverified search snippets. Per /root/.ccr/README.md, a 403/407 org-policy denial should be reported, not retried or routed around. This is now a structural failure of the hunt step, not a one-off: it will keep producing empty results every day until the environment's network egress policy is widened (a job-board allowlist — Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workday, and company career domains — or a switch to a less restrictive policy tier).
